notes:
I couldn't do this research. The research tool told me I had no more tool calls left for this turn, so I never read any of the sources: Enduring Word, Bible Hub (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit), StudyLight, NET Bible notes, Precept Austin, or the Catholic, Orthodox and other sites on your list.

Because you asked for notes based only on pages I actually read, with a URL for each point, I haven't written any verse notes. Anything I wrote now would come from my own memory, which your rules don't allow.

When you ask again in a new message, I'll go through Job 37 verse by verse:

1. **Traditional reading:** Enduring Word, plus Ellicott, the Pulpit Commentary and Gill on Bible Hub or StudyLight, plus Precept Austin.
2. **Where Protestant traditions differ:** each tradition's own teachers, for example Wesley's notes for Methodists, Spurgeon or Desiring God for Baptists, and Ligonier or The Gospel Coalition for Reformed views. The verses I'd look at most are v. 13 (what the clouds are sent for) and v. 24 (who "the wise in heart" are).
3. **Other views:** NET Bible notes and Bible Odyssey for modern scholarship, New Advent and Catholic.com for Catholic readings, and OCA for Orthodox ones. I'd include popular teachings like prosperity or word of faith only if these sites actually discuss them in connection with this chapter.

Each note will cite its source URL, and I'll leave out any verse or view I can't find.
